Author: Andre Mari Coppola / Toen.

Official source: https://opengameart.org/content/toens-medieval-strategy-sprite-pack-v10-16x16

Author's distribution: http://toen.itch.io/toens-medieval-strategy

The page category displays CC BY 3.0, but the author's description, original
sheet footer and bundled `License and atribution info.txt` explicitly grant
CC BY 4.0. We use that grant and preserve the bundled text as `LICENSE.txt`.

`medieval-strategy.png` is the archive's
`Tile-set - Toen's Medieval Strategy (16x16) - v.1.0.png`, renamed only. It is
112 by 832 pixels, with a seven-column grid of 16-pixel frames. The copyright
footer is not used as gameplay art.

SHA-256: d39d3e776967ce5c055c26e0904de75cb062a876716fb0cbfc6913a3650ad4af
Size: 50926 bytes.

Presentation changes: selected tile frames are enlarged without smoothing,
composited into connected terrain, and arranged into troop formations. Enemy
units are mirrored; spent units are dimmed. Existing flags, wings, HP and team
markers are retained. Movement changes runtime position, while detailed battle
presentation moves separate frame regions. These are static source frames,
not a supplied walking/attack animation. Original PNG pixels are unedited.

Copyright remains with the author. Credits, source URL, license link and
presentation changes must remain with redistributions.
